description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPI class, which serves as an API endpoint for retrieving summarized attendance data of employees within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to handle GET requests for fetching attendance summaries, applying filters such as date ranges and employee IDs, and manages validation rules and access control. The class utilizes traits for date-time helpers, user role management, and attendance services, and integrates OpenAPI annotations for documentation.
